svg.aria-label: Mission 03: Holdout. Phones down. Together. A campfire you keep alive with your friends. Everyone goes dark at the same time; if anyone breaks, everyone sees. No account, no ads, no tracking. Status: beta, Android waitlist. Launched 6 OCT 2026. holdout.gautamkhosla.com/beta. Opens holdout.gautamkhosla.com.
